SELECT 
	Grouping=1,
	InvoiceNo = ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(serviceoheader.ServiceInvCode,  12))), '') + ISNULL('-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(serviceoheader.SaleInvCode, 12))), ''),
	IssueReqInvCode =NULL,
	itemname = service.name,
	users.username,  
	accounts.name, 
	dbo.serviceoheader.serviceOcode,   
	dbo.serviceOheader.date,  
	dbo.serviceOheader.headerno, 
	dbo.serviceOheader.discperc,  
	dbo.serviceOheader.flatdisc,	 
	dbo.serviceOheader.misccharges,   
	dbo.serviceOheader.ServiceInvGSTPerc,   
	dbo.serviceOheader.custcode,   
	dbo.serviceOheader.remarks,
	dbo.service.servicecode,   
	price = dbo.serviceOdetail.price, 
	serviceflatdisc = dbo.serviceOdetail.serviceflatdisc, 
	Qty = dbo.serviceOdetail.qty,
	ServiceFlatTax = dbo.serviceOdetail.ServiceFlatTax,
	ServiceGSTPerc = dbo.serviceOdetail.ServiceGSTPerc,
	servicedate = dbo.serviceOdetail.date,
	advance = dbo.serviceodetail.cashreceived,
	invadvance = dbo.serviceoheader.cashreceived,
	servicedetail_discperc = dbo.serviceOdetail.discperc, 
	customername='                                  ',
	dbo.serviceOheader.PatientCode,
	dbo.serviceOheader.AdmissionCode,

	Patient=(SELECT Patient.Name FROM Patient WHERE ServiceOHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	RegNo=(SELECT Patient.Regno FROM Patient WHERE ServiceOHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	Reference=(SELECT Patient.Reference FROM Patient WHERE ServiceOHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode),
	PatientUnit=(SELECT Unit.Name FROM Patient, Unit WHERE ServiceOHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode AND Patient.UnitCode = Unit.UnitCode),
	PatientRank=(SELECT Rank.Name FROM Patient, Rank WHERE ServiceOHeader.PatientCode = Patient.PatientCode AND Patient.RankCode = Rank.RankCode),
	Operationdate=dbo.serviceOheader.Operationdate,
	DischargeDate=dbo.serviceOheader.DischargeDate,
	PatientRefBy=dbo.serviceOheader.PatientRefBy
FROM 
	dbo.serviceOheader,   
	dbo.serviceOdetail,  
	service, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.serviceOheader.serviceOcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.serviceOheader.serviceOcode = dbo.serviceOdetail.serviceOcode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceOheader.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.serviceOheader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( serviceOdetail.servicecode = service.servicecode )
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Grouping=2,
	InvoiceNo = (SELECT ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(serviceoheader.ServiceInvCode,  12))), '') + ISNULL('-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(serviceoheader.SaleInvCode, 12))), '') FROM serviceoheader WHERE serviceoheader.ServiceOCode = :ra_InvCode),
	IssueReqInvCode =IssueReqHeader.IssueReqInvCode,
	itemname = item.name,
	users.username,  
	accounts.name, 
	Code = :ra_InvCode,
	Date=IssueReqHeader.date,  
	HeaderNo = 1 ,
	DiscPerc=0,  
	FlatDisc=0,
	misccharges=0,   
	ServiceInvGSTPerc=0,   
	CustCode=IssueReqHeader.AccCode,   
	Remarks=IssueReqHeader.remarks,
	ServiceCode=Item.ICode,   
	price = IssueReqDetail.SalePrice, 
	serviceflatdisc = 0,
	Qty = IssueReqDetail.qty,
	ServiceFlatTax = 0.00,
	ServiceGSTPerc = 0.00,
	servicedate = NULL,
	advance = 0,
	invadvance = 0.00,
	servicedetail_discperc = 0.00, 
	customername='                                  ',
	PatientCode = (SELECT dbo.serviceOheader.PatientCode FROM serviceOheader WHERE serviceOheader.ServiceOCode = :ra_InvCode),
	AdmissionCode = (SELECT dbo.serviceOheader.AdmissionCode FROM serviceOheader WHERE serviceOheader.ServiceOCode = :ra_InvCode),
	Patient=(SELECT Patient.Name FROM Patient, serviceOheader WHERE serviceOheader.ServiceOCode = :ra_InvCode AND serviceOheader.patientcode=patient.patientcode),
	RegNo=(SELECT Patient.Regno FROM Patient, serviceOheader WHERE serviceOheader.ServiceOCode = :ra_InvCode AND serviceOheader.patientcode=patient.patientcode),
	Reference=(SELECT Patient.Reference FROM Patient, serviceOheader WHERE serviceOheader.ServiceOCode = :ra_InvCode AND serviceOheader.patientcode=patient.patientcode),
	PatientUnit=(SELECT Unit.Name FROM Patient, Unit, serviceOheader WHERE serviceOheader.ServiceOCode = :ra_InvCode AND serviceOheader.patientcode=patient.patientcode AND Patient.UnitCode = Unit.UnitCode),
	PatientRank=(SELECT Rank.Name FROM Patient, Rank, serviceOheader WHERE serviceOheader.ServiceOCode = :ra_InvCode AND serviceOheader.patientcode=patient.patientcode AND Patient.RankCode = Rank.RankCode),
	Operationdate=NULL,
	DischargeDate=NULL,
	PatientRefBy=NULL
FROM 
	dbo.IssueReqHeader,   
	dbo.IssueReqDetail,  
	Item, 
	accounts,
	users
WHERE 
	ISNULL((SELECT COUNT(IH.serviceOcode) FROM IssueHeader IH WHERE IH.serviceOcode = :ra_InvCode), 0) = 0 AND
	( dbo.IssueReqHeader.serviceOcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.IssueReqHeader.IssueReqInvCode = dbo.IssueReqDetail.IssueReqInvCode )  AND 
	( dbo.IssueReqHeader.AccCode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.IssueReqHeader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( dbo.IssueReqDetail.ICode = Item.ICode )
UNION ALL
